title: The Signature Open Educational Resource Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Reusable educational materials with documented licensing. The Open Educational Resource Database catalogs openly licensed educational materials beyond textbooks: full courses, lesson plans, simulations, question banks, and multimedia, each with its license, subject, level, and reuse permissions. Records verify the license against the source. The Signature side adds remixing guides showing how to adapt materials legally.
capabilities: Catalog courses, lessons, simulations, and question banks
Document licenses and reuse permissions per item
Organize by subject and education level
Verify licenses against sources
Guide legal remixing and adaptation

title: The Signature Open Educational Resource Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout.
